QF.id: SIA Case Studies on SAS Standards_40

question.text: Under the AB Responsible Services IWMP, a 76% water availability increase is reported in project villages. The SIA's BEST approach to verify is:

answer.text: Compare to the national average water availability
Desk review of rainfall and water-availability data, physical inspection of water assets (check dams, borewells, farm ponds, pipelines), and interviews / FGDs / surveys with stakeholders

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook supports a multi-method verification for IWMP outcomes — desk review of rainfall and water-availability data, physical inspection of water assets such as check dams, borewells, farm ponds and pipelines, and stakeholder interviews, FGDs and surveys. The Trap: Believing the SE abandons scepticism. Benchmarking is not verification. Verbal-only inquiry is single-source. Note: Combine desk-review, physical inspection and stakeholder methods so the conclusion is supported by triangulated evidence.
